headline: Türkiye Economic Confidence Index Falls to 97.3 in October
summary: Türkiye's economic confidence index dropped 3.9 percent month-on-month in October to 97.3 from 101.3 in September, according to the Turkish Statistical Institute.
why: Economic confidence indices aggregate sentiment across consumers, manufacturers, and services, offering an early indicator of GDP growth momentum.

impacts.name: Türkiye
impacts.why: A drop below the 100 benchmark indicates deteriorating economic sentiment among consumers and businesses.
